# Defensive fixture: large POSITIVE deltas whose p-values are above alpha.
# benchstat normally prints "~" instead of a delta in this case, so this
# combination should not occur in practice -- the fixture exists to prove the
# gate consults the p-value and does not fire on statistical noise.
                                        │     base     │                 pr                 │
                                        │    sec/op    │    sec/op     vs base              │
Utils/$load-4                             13.35m ± ∞ ¹   18.69m ± ∞ ¹  +40.00% (p=0.412 n=5)
Utils/tomulset-no-memoize-benchmark-4      1.556 ± ∞ ¹    2.334 ± ∞ ¹  +50.00% (p=0.056 n=5)
Utils/trim-4                              1.301m ± ∞ ¹   1.298m ± ∞ ¹       ~ (p=0.841 n=5)
geomean                                   53.15m         71.60m        +34.71%
¹ need >= 6 samples for confidence interval at level 0.95
